headline: Ripple Obtains Regulatory Approval to Launch US National Trust Bank
summary: The US Office of the Comptroller of the Currency approved the establishment of Ripple National Trust Bank. CEO Brad Garlinghouse confirmed the regulatory green light.
why: Ripple Labs is a digital payments company providing blockchain-based financial network solutions and issuing the XRP token.

impacts.name: XRP
impacts.why: Federal banking approval enhances institutional legitimacy and adoption prospects for Ripple's platform.

why_moved: Approval from the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency cleared the way for Ripple to expand digital trust bank services in the US.
